clockModes.decision_quality: checkpoint and await all decision work before advancing economic events; equal schedule in every arm
clockModes.operational_latency: previous published policy keeps trading; log evidence age and publication lag separately
clockModes.replay: saved events only; no provider calls

toolBoundaries.queries: registered metrics/dimensions/time windows; no arbitrary SQL writes
toolBoundaries.datasets: shared train/serve feature plans; no latent needs, hidden wallets, future outcomes or seeds
toolBoundaries.trials: completed development markets only; never probe active confirmation future
toolBoundaries.nativePayments: existing saved sandbox adapter, separate from simulation revenue; off in research

publicationRequirements: same tested and deployed contract hash
observation cutoff valid for clock mode
maturity and feature parity checks pass
compare merchant and platform outcomes, not classifier loss alone
labelHeads: funding before request expiry, with pending authorization censored
capture conditional on funding and fulfillment state
futureConfirmationSeeds: register after implementation is frozen; not opened in this research
outcomeMetrics: modeled platform net after model cost
valid artifact handoffs, revisions, recovery, model calls and latency
noveltyClaim: Local integration proposal; not a claim that this architecture is unprecedented or already profitable.
